SETTINGS.TITLE: Platform Settings
SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: Configure global rules, security and system behavior.
SETTINGS.BILLING_DESC: Accepted payment methods and financial settings.
SETTINGS.PAY_CASH_SUB: Accept in-person payments at the counter.
SETTINGS.PAY_OM_SUB: Direct integration with the Orange Money Guinea API.
SETTINGS.PAY_MOMO_SUB: Direct integration with the MTN Mobile Money API.
SETTINGS.2FA_SUB: Enforced for every professional account (doctors, pharmacists, CHWs, administrators) at each login. Patients are exempt.
SETTINGS.CONSENT_TITLE: Care consents granted when a record is created
SETTINGS.CONSENT_SUB: Automatically grants "medical record access" and "SMS reminders" to each new patient. FHIR export and anonymised research always remain the patient's choice, and each consent can be withdrawn from their space.
SETTINGS.EBOLA_WARNING: Any detection triggers an immediate national emergency.
SETTINGS.AI_ENABLE_SUB: Allows the CHW space to call the triage assistant. When disabled, the server rejects the evaluation.
SETTINGS.OFFLINE_MODE_SUB: Allows CHWs to record entries without network; they are replayed automatically when the connection returns. When disabled, any offline entry is rejected.
SETTINGS.SYNC_FREQ_HINT: Interval at which the CHW space pushes its local queue and pulls server changes while connected.
SETTINGS.USSD_TIMEOUT_HINT: Delay before the menu expires on basic phones.
SETTINGS.PRESCRIPTION_DESC: Rules applied to every prescription issued on the platform. They are regulatory: a prescription presented after its validity period is refused at the pharmacy.
SETTINGS.PRESCRIPTION_VALIDITY_HINT: Counted from the prescriber's signature, not from drafting.
SETTINGS.PRESCRIPTION_CODE_HINT: Code given to the patient and checked at the counter. Longer is safer but harder to copy.
SETTINGS.PRESCRIPTION_REG_HINT: Narcotics and psychotropics. Always shorter, and a doctor's signature is required regardless.
SETTINGS.PRESCRIPTION_RENEW_HINT: Cap on what a prescriber may grant. A controlled product is never renewable.
SETTINGS.PRESCRIPTION_SIGN_SUB: Pending regulatory decision (D2). When off, a prescription written by a community health worker can be dispensed as soon as the consultation is closed. When on, a doctor must validate it first - which blocks dispensing where there is no doctor.
SETTINGS.STRUCTURES_HINT: Each facility's profile (name, type, address) is managed from the Facilities page.
SETTINGS.MARGE_HINT: Applied to the national reference price when a pharmacist adds a medication to stock without entering a margin.
SETTINGS.IDENTITY_DESC: Name, logo and contact details shown everywhere: public site, sign-in pages, e-mails, SMS and documents. Change them here, never in the code.
SETTINGS.IDENTITY_LOGO_HINT: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, 2 MB max. Transparent background recommended.
SETTINGS.IDENTITY_LOGO_NONE: No logo: the name is shown alone.
SETTINGS.IDENTITY_NOM_COURT_HINT: No accents, 20 characters max. Empty = derived from the name (e.g. KENEYA).
SETTINGS.IDENTITY_EMAIL_EXPEDITEUR_HINT: Empty = platform name. The sending address stays the one configured on the server.
SETTINGS.IDENTITY_COPYRIGHT_HINT: Empty = "© year Name — All rights reserved".
